sources.snippet: To address these issues, this paper proposes a Motion-aware Visual State Space Model (MVSSM). Unlike conventional methods, MVSSM dynamically scans along the motion trajectories between video frames, enabling more efficient capture of spatial features while significantly reducing computational cost.
